title: Add deprecated warnings to `TestClient` on use of `timeout` argument
description:
Implements the solution in https://github.com/encode/starlette/issues/1108#issuecomment-2570876216

# Checklist

- [x] I understand that this PR may be closed in case there was no previous discussion. (This doesn't apply to typos!)
- [x] I've added a test for each change that was introduced, and I tried as much as possible to make a single atomic change.
- [ ] I've updated the documentation accordingly.

Edit by @kludex:
- Closes https://github.com/encode/starlette/issues/1108
patch_diff:
diff --git a/starlette/testclient.py b/starlette/testclient.py
index fb2ad6e35..d54025e52 100644
--- a/starlette/testclient.py
+++ b/starlette/testclient.py
@@ -7,6 +7,7 @@
 import math
 import sys
 import typing
+import warnings
 from concurrent.futures import Future
 from types import GeneratorType
 from urllib.parse import unquote, urljoin
@@ -426,6 +427,12 @@ def request(  # type: ignore[override]
         timeout: httpx._types.TimeoutTypes | httpx._client.UseClientDefault = httpx._client.USE_CLIENT_DEFAULT,
         extensions: dict[str, typing.Any] | None = None,
     ) -> httpx.Response:
+        if timeout is not httpx.USE_CLIENT_DEFAULT:
+            warnings.warn(
+                "You should not use the 'timeout' argument with the TestClient. "
+                "See https://github.com/encode/starlette/issues/1108 for more information.",
+                DeprecationWarning,
+            )
         url = self._merge_url(url)
         return super().request(
             method,
test_diff:
diff --git a/tests/test_testclient.py b/tests/test_testclient.py
index 478dbca46..c6a3edafc 100644
--- a/tests/test_testclient.py
+++ b/tests/test_testclient.py
@@ -422,3 +422,9 @@ async def app(scope: Scope, receive: Receive, send: Send) -> None:
     with client.websocket_connect("/hello-world", params={"foo": "bar"}) as websocket:

+
+
+def test_timeout_deprecation() -> None:
+    with pytest.deprecated_call(match="You should not use the 'timeout' argument with the TestClient."):
+        client = TestClient(mock_service)
+        client.get("/", timeout=1)
